concept: Auto Scaling: scheduled scaling + target tracking for predictable peaks
tests: How to combine scaling out ahead of a predictable morning peak with scaling in at night (choose two).
expected: Scheduled scaling — add capacity before the morning peak; target tracking — remove capacity as utilization drops at night. Triggers: "predictable daily traffic", "spikes every morning", "control cost".
why_not: Permanent overprovisioning for the peak — overpaying off-peak; manual management without Auto Scaling — errors and operational burden.
